subject: SCIENCE
title: Homes That Meet Needs
introduction: A tadpole lives in a pond and an earthworm lives in damp soil. What resources make each environment a good home?

vocabulary.definition: Everything around a living thing, including its land, water, air, and other organisms.
The place where a person or animal lives and finds what it needs.
Something a living thing must have to stay alive, such as water, food, or shelter.

activities.instruction: Watch Milo match organisms with environments that meet their needs.
activities.content: A suitable environment provides the particular resources and conditions an organism needs.

feedback.retry: Check the organism’s needs for food, water, shelter, and space before choosing a home.

items.prompt: Milo sees a tadpole in a pond and an earthworm in damp soil. Which statement about environments is true?

options.text: A habitat is only a sleeping place
A suitable environment provides the resources and conditions an organism needs.

items.explanation: A suitable environment provides resources such as food, water, shelter, and space. Different organisms need different conditions, and a habitat is more than a sleeping place.

items.prompt: Maxine watches a tadpole swim. Which environment matches it?
items.explanation: A tadpole needs water, so a pond can meet its needs. Dry sand, an icebox, or a bookshelf does not provide the right conditions.

items.prompt: Milo reads four habitat cards. Which statement is NOT true?

options.text: A pond can suit a tadpole
A tree canopy can suit some birds
Damp soil can suit an earthworm

items.explanation: Different organisms need different conditions, so one home cannot suit every organism. Ponds, tree canopies, and damp soil can each support particular organisms.

items.prompt: A tadpole swims in a pond. Why might that pond suit it?

options.text: It provides water and resources it needs.
It gives the tadpole a school grade.

items.explanation: A pond provides water and other resources a tadpole needs while it grows. It is not paper, and not every animal can live in a pond.

items.prompt: Milo finds an earthworm under damp soil. Which environment suits it?
items.explanation: Earthworms need moist soil for moisture, food, and shelter. An icebox, dry sand, or hot pavement does not provide the right conditions.
